description: Go 1.26+ high-performance AI proxy gateway refactored from 9router (Next.js)

phases.name: Maintenance Mode (perpetual sentinel)
phases.description: Not a development phase. Activates when no pending dev phase exists or when manually triggered. Never marked done.
tasks: Check GitHub Issues for bug reports or feature requests
Run go build ./... && go test ./... to verify project health
Review and merge dependabot PRs if safe
Fix reported issues and push patches (tag v1.x.y)
Upstream sync: compare upstream_commits hashes, port relevant changes
Check 9router open-sse/providers/registry/ for new providers or baseUrl changes
If no action needed: report 'no pending work' and exit
phases.notes: 2026-07-28: URL double-append fix, Qoder COSY port, OpenCode Free, /v1/models free exposure, Gemini schema sanitization (#2877), Kimi apikey routing (#2881), raw body preservation (c97963c). 2026-07-30: upstream sync to 6fcd273 — Gemini empty schema fix, 10 new providers, Claude Opus 5 + Gemini 3.6 Flash + Laguna catalog. 2026-07-31: nil-slice JSON null fix (all list endpoints), Media card field mapping fix, data dir unified to ~/.cyrene-gateway.

phases.name: Core Infrastructure & Database Layer
phases.summary: Project layout (cmd/gateway + internal/), SQLite via modernc.org/sqlite, settings repo, KV store, graceful shutdown, slog JSON logging.

phases.name: Provider & Connection Management
phases.summary: Provider nodes repo, account fallback (cooldown + exponential backoff + model locks), priority-based credential selection, connection status, provider CRUD.

phases.name: Model Resolution & Combos
phases.summary: Model string parsing, alias resolution, combo system (fallback + round-robin + sticky), model availability, combo CRUD, unit tests.

phases.name: OpenAI-Compatible API Surface
phases.summary: /v1/chat/completions + /v1/messages + /v1/models + /v1/embeddings, middleware chain, SSE streaming proxy, format translation (OpenAI/Claude/Gemini), usage extraction, integration tests.

phases.name: Dashboard Panel System
phases.summary: CLI params + env vars, go:embed panel serving (local dir > downloaded cache > embedded), dist.zip support.

phases.name: Authentication & API Keys
phases.summary: HMAC-signed API key generation/validation, Bearer middleware, cookie-based dashboard session auth, login/logout.

phases.name: Usage Tracking & Observability
phases.summary: Usage history repo, token extraction (stream + non-stream), daily aggregation, request details, /api/usage/* endpoints.

phases.name: Dashboard Management API
phases.summary: Full REST API: providers CRUD, provider-nodes CRUD, combos, proxy-pools CRUD, /api/health.

phases.name: Advanced Features & Enhancements
phases.summary: OAuth token refresh (pre-check + on-401 retry), loop guard, termination prompt, proxy pool rotation, provider test, max_tokens clamping.

phases.name: Provider Registry Expansion & Categorization
phases.summary: Full 9router registry port: 70 apikey + 20 oauth + 18 freeTier + 5 free + 2 webCookie, category/authModes metadata, grouped /api/registry.

phases.name: Provider Detail Management
phases.summary: Connection test with latency, credential editing, custom models, /api/providers/{id}/models, cooldown display.

phases.name: OAuth Authorization Flow
phases.summary: Authorize URL (PKCE), callback code exchange, device code flow, manual token import, panel OAuth modals, token refresh in chat path. NOTE: scaffold only — real per-provider refresh comes in Phase 33-34.

phases.name: Quota Tracker & Token Saver
phases.summary: Per-connection quota limits, quota-aware fallback, /api/quota, RTK caveman/ponytail compression.

phases.name: Tunnel & Tailscale
phases.summary: Tailscale detection/install/enable/disable, /api/tunnel/status, graceful degradation.

phases.name: WebUI Iterations (superseded by Phase 29)
phases.summary: Thirteen incremental webui phases (Vue 3 scaffold, provider cards, media, CLI tools, usage, i18n, MITM, detail parity, polish, full overhaul, model metadata). All frontend code was deleted and rewritten from scratch in Phase 29. Backend endpoints created during these phases (internal/media, internal/cli, internal/mitm, /api/usage/stream, /api/skills, /api/endpoints, model metadata) remain valid and are consumed by the new UI.

phases.name: WebUI Ground-Up Rebuild
phases.summary: Full src/ rewrite: design tokens (teal→violet, glassmorphism, dark/light), expandable Media sub-nav, Tab-based Provider Detail, 17 routes, typed Pinia store (null-safe), pure-CSS animations (stagger/spring/ambient orbs, prefers-reduced-motion), mobile collapsible sidebar. Vite 8 + Vue 3.5 + TS, zero new deps.

phases.name: Provider Transport Layer
phases.summary: Unified transport layer (internal/provider/transport.go): per-provider Transport{baseUrl,format,headers,urlSuffix,auth} resolved at proxy time, scheme-aware auth injection (bearer/raw/query) + hook framework (kimiHeaders X-Msh-*), dual-auth (kimi OAuth x-api-key vs apikey Bearer). Refactored chat (single+combo+messages) + connection test to use it. 15 transport tests incl. mock-upstream header validation for 6 auth shapes.

phases.name: API Key Providers — Batch 1 (25)
phases.summary: Transport correctness fixes vs 9router: gemini apikey→x-goog-api-key header (raw), glm/minimax/minimax-cn→?beta=true + x-api-key raw + CLAUDE_API_HEADERS. Added ProviderInfo.APIKeyURL (display.notice.apiKeyUrl) for 22 batch-1 providers + panel 'Get API Key' link in Add modal. New internal/usage quota framework (port of 9router services/usage): deepseek/glm/glm-cn/minimax/minimax-cn fetchers + GET /api/usage/connection/{id}. 6 transport tests + 8 quota tests (mock upstream). NOTE: baichuan/stepfun/zero-one have NO standalone 9router registry entry (only appear as models inside aggregators e.g. commandcode/siliconflow) — not added; revisit if upstream adds them. OAuth-path quota (gemini CLI/claude/codex/kimi) deferred to Phase 33-34.

phases.name: API Key Providers — Batch 2 (45)
phases.summary: Transport correctness for all 45 batch-2 apikey providers: ValidateURL (17 providers), ThinkingFormat (blackbox/siliconflow/venice), ForceStream (openai/commandcode/codebuddy-intl), Headers (commandcode). Added devin-cli + codebuddy-intl to registry (112 total). Media registry fixes: BFL bfl.ml→bfl.ai, fal.run→queue.fal.run, stability/nebius embedding URLs, model lists synced. Vitest setup (23 tests): format utils, api lib, store null-safety. Registry transport completeness test.

phases.name: OAuth Framework + Batch 1 (8 providers)
phases.summary: Token refresh engine: per-provider profiles (form/json, extra headers, error classification), singleflight dedup, per-provider lead times (codex 5d, iflow 24h). 8 providers: kimi (X-Msh-*), xai (OIDC discovery), claude (JSON), google (client_secret), qwen (resource_url), codex (unrecoverable detection), kiro (multi-path IDC/social), iflow (Basic auth). POST /api/oauth/{provider}/refresh, panel token countdown + refresh button. 12 tests.

phases.name: OAuth Batch 2 + Dual-Auth (12+24)
phases.summary: Refresh profiles: github, cline/clinepass (workos:), codebuddy-cn/intl (X-Refresh-Token), trae (ExchangeToken), copilot multi-step (GitHub→Copilot token). No-refresh: kilocode/cursor/zed/windsurf. Auth hooks: clineHeaders, kilocodeOrg. Dual-auth: OAuth-preferred selection with apikey fallback. Cookie auth scheme for webCookie providers. Registry metadata: github copilot headers, codebuddy transport, cline/kilocode hooks. 12 tests.

phases.name: Free/FreeTier Providers + E2E Verification
phases.summary: mimo-free marked Hidden (service ended). E2E test suite: 11 providers across all categories (openai/deepseek/openrouter/cerebras/groq/nvidia/opencode/api-airforce/github/anthropic/gemini), NoAuth auto-provision, SSE streaming, registry completeness, category consistency. README provider support matrix.
